decisions.subject: Narrative concept

options_considered.label: Your Drink Server Is Rescue Crew
options_considered.reason: Best complete myth-to-reality arc and strongest object-morph hook.

options_considered.label: The Smile Is a Scanner
options_considered.reason: Strong mystery but too narrow for the full brief.
options_considered.rejected_because: Would require extra exposition to cover training, evacuation, and pay.

options_considered.label: Ninety Seconds Changes the Job
options_considered.reason: Memorable statistic and hero visual.
options_considered.rejected_because: Risks making one certification rule feel like the entire job.

decisions.reason: It fulfills every required fact in one compact three-act reversal and naturally supports the locked paper-collage style.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Available locally; supports deterministic bespoke animation and word-level caption timing.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: HTML and GSAP would suit tactile kinetic motion.
options_considered.rejected_because: Runtime not available on this machine; npm package is not resolvable.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg only
options_considered.reason: Available and reliable for packaging.
options_considered.rejected_because: Cannot deliver the locked bespoke motion and caption character without a major downgrade.

decisions.reason: It is the only available runtime that preserves the motion-led paper-collage delivery promise and word-level captions.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Atelier
options_considered.reason: A one-off hero explainer needs a bespoke visual system and scene-specific animation.

options_considered.label: Templated
options_considered.reason: Faster and reliable.
options_considered.rejected_because: Stock card scenes would undermine the locked tactile paper-collage identity.

decisions.reason: Hand-authored scenes can maintain paper texture, physical transitions, and visual distinctness across the entire short.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: Google Chirp 3 HD Aoede
options_considered.reason: Configured warm female voice with SSML pacing controls.

options_considered.label: Piper local
options_considered.reason: Free and offline.
options_considered.rejected_because: Not installed and lower expected naturalness for the requested calm warmth.

decisions.reason: It is the configured voice most closely matching the brief while keeping spend negligible.

decisions.subject: Background music source

options_considered.label: Pixabay licensed music
options_considered.reason: Configured, polished, commercial-use, and free.

options_considered.label: Google generated music
options_considered.reason: Tailored mood and duration.
options_considered.rejected_because: Paid generation is unnecessary unless free search fails.

options_considered.label: No music
options_considered.reason: Zero cost.
options_considered.rejected_because: The brief explicitly requires music and the comic stop-motion rhythm benefits from it.

decisions.reason: It fulfills the music requirement without compromising the hard budget.

decisions.subject: Remaining production approval gates

options_considered.label: Print, select, and self-approve first-ranked option
options_considered.reason: Explicitly required because nobody is at the keyboard.

options_considered.label: Pause for human at every gate
options_considered.reason: Normal guided policy.
options_considered.rejected_because: Contradicts the user's explicit unattended-session rule.

decisions.reason: The user explicitly pre-authorized self-approval at every gate after printing the gate, options, and pick.

decisions.subject: Visual asset production spend

options_considered.label: Local bespoke vector collage
options_considered.reason: Exact style continuity and zero provider cost.

options_considered.label: Google Imagen batch
options_considered.reason: Faster plate generation.
options_considered.rejected_because: Higher continuity risk and unnecessary spend for vector-friendly artwork.

decisions.reason: It leaves nearly the entire $5 cap untouched while improving consistency for this graphic style.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: macOS Samantha local voice
options_considered.reason: Installed, female US English, deterministic, free, and available in the unattended session.

options_considered.label: Google Chirp 3 HD Aoede
options_considered.reason: Approved warm cloud voice.
options_considered.rejected_because: Changed after the provider returned HTTP 403 Forbidden before producing the approval sample.

options_considered.label: Google legacy voice retry
options_considered.reason: Could reduce model-specific access risk.
options_considered.rejected_because: The Cloud TTS endpoint itself is forbidden, so another model is unlikely to succeed.

options_considered.label: Wait for cloud access
options_considered.reason: Would preserve the preferred provider.
options_considered.rejected_because: Nobody is at the keyboard and the user required autonomous completion.

decisions.reason: This is the only installed path that preserves a calm female narrator and autonomous delivery after the approved provider failed authorization.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: Piper en_US-lessac-medium
options_considered.reason: Neural female US-English model and Piper executable are already installed locally; deterministic and free.

options_considered.label: macOS Samantha local voice
options_considered.reason: Installed system voice.
options_considered.rejected_because: Changed after it produced an AIFF container with zero audio samples.

options_considered.label: Google Chirp 3 HD Aoede
options_considered.reason: Preferred natural cloud voice.
options_considered.rejected_because: HTTP 403 Forbidden from the Cloud TTS endpoint.

options_considered.label: No narration
options_considered.reason: Avoids speech generation.
options_considered.rejected_because: Violates the locked calm female narrator requirement.

decisions.reason: It is the first functioning, already-installed neural female voice path and stays within the registered tts_selector workflow.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime

options_considered.label: Browser Canvas atelier capture + FFmpeg packaging
options_considered.reason: The existing browser surface can preserve bespoke object motion, paper texture, captions, narration, and music; FFmpeg can package the captured stream to MP4.

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Approved and fully authored React composition.
options_considered.rejected_because: Changed after both bundled Chromium and installed Google Chrome failed macOS Mach-port registration under the execution sandbox.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: HTML/GSAP could express the motion language.
options_considered.rejected_because: Runtime unavailable because the npm package is not resolvable.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg still montage
options_considered.reason: Reliable local packaging.
options_considered.rejected_because: Would break the approved motion-led delivery promise.

decisions.reason: This is the only functioning path that retains true per-object animation and every locked audio/caption requirement while still delivering a local MP4.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime

options_considered.label: Bespoke SVG frame atelier plus FFmpeg
options_considered.reason: The project-local renderer preserves true per-object motion, paper texture, exact caption timing, and deterministic 1080x1920 frames; FFmpeg provides reliable video packaging.

options_considered.label: Browser Canvas atelier capture plus FFmpeg
options_considered.reason: Would preserve the same visual grammar.
options_considered.rejected_because: Changed after both external Chrome and the in-app browser automation surfaces rejected capture access.

options_considered.label: Pause for browser access
options_considered.reason: Could retain the browser capture route.
options_considered.rejected_because: Nobody is at the keyboard and the user explicitly required autonomous completion.

decisions.reason: It is the functioning local runtime that preserves the approved atelier motion language without provider spend.
